profile.name: Mohammad Munna Mia
profile.headline: SQA Engineer
profile.heroIntro: Hey there, I'm Mohammad Munna Mia — an SQA Engineer focused on manual testing, test automation, regression, API and end-to-end testing, with a background in front-end and full-stack development.
profile.about:
Hi there! I'm Mohammad Munna Mia, an SQA Engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. At Spectrum Software & Consulting (SSCL) I test OptiFin, a Supply Chain Finance solution used by leading banks in Bangladesh — running functional, regression and on-site User Acceptance Testing with banking stakeholders, and automating test cases with Cypress.

Before moving into quality assurance, I worked as a front-end and full-stack developer, building responsive web applications with React.js, Next.js, Svelte, TypeScript and the MERN stack. That development background helps me understand how software is built, write maintainable automation and report defects developers can act on.

I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering from IUBAT. I believe in building quality into software, not testing it in later.

sqaProjects.title: Cypress Automation with BDD Framework
sqaProjects.summary: A behaviour-driven Cypress test suite for OptiFin, a Supply Chain Finance web application. Scenarios are written in Gherkin and mapped to reusable step definitions, locator classes and shared test-data modules, covering admin user management, configuration and CAD Maker workflows across multiple finance products.
highlights: 67 feature files with 490+ Gherkin scenarios, organised by module
Shared Background steps and @positive / @negative tags for focused runs
Step definitions backed by 66 locator classes and shared test-data modules
sqaProjects.snippet:
Background: Open Website With Valid url
    Given Open Browser and Visit Website

@positive1
Scenario: Verify that Interest Rate is checking properly
    When Enter Cad_Maker User ID
    Then Enter Cad_Maker Password
    When Click on Login
    Then Click on EOD OK

sqaProjects.title: CBS Onboarding Automation
sqaProjects.summary: Cypress automation for the onboarding workflow of a mock Core Banking System (CBS) in the OptiFin staging environment. It bulk-creates customer accounts (CD, OD and ASG) for each customer, saves them for reuse, and creates and approves Factoring Finance limits through a maker–checker flow.
highlights: Interactive Node.js prompts for account counts, account selection and module
Created accounts persisted to a JSON store with cy.task and reused for limits
Maker submits and Authorizer approves each limit; rates validated before the run
Seeded generator of 5,000 company names for realistic test data

projects.title: Artcon
projects.tagline: Web Platform for a Leading Bangladeshi Art Agency
projects.description:
A content-driven web platform for Artcon, one of Bangladesh's leading art agencies, presenting its exhibitions, artists, collections, publications and events — with virtual-reality gallery tours and a CMS the Artcon team uses to publish without a developer.

Built by the Edistys team with SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Sanity.io. My contribution covered front-end work and manual QA: designing and executing test cases, reporting UI/API defects and validating integrations.

projects.title: Ryoko Travel Agency
projects.tagline: Online Travel Agency Platform — B2C, B2B & Admin CRM
projects.description:
A full-stack online travel agency platform handling visa applications, airport transfers, flight bookings and holiday packages — with a consumer site, a reseller (B2B) portal and an internal admin CRM. It includes dynamic visa application flows, passport OCR, document uploads, payments and role-based access.

Built by the Edistys team with SvelteKit, Hono.js, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL and Payload CMS. My contribution was quality assurance: designing and executing test cases, identifying UI/API defects and validating integrations.

projects.title: Dialleads
projects.tagline: Marketing Website for an AI Call-Agent Platform
projects.description:
A fast, responsive marketing website for Dialleads, an AI-powered phone call automation platform whose voice agents make and take calls for businesses. The site explains a technical product with audio samples, a traditional-vs-AI comparison, industry use-case pages and an onboarding flow, all managed through a CMS.

Built at Edistys with SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Sanity.io.

projects.title: Tanzi Stretto
projects.tagline: E-commerce Platform for a Handcrafted Bangles Brand
projects.description:
A mobile-first e-commerce platform for Tanzi Stretto, a Bangladeshi brand of handcrafted bangles and jewelry — with a social feed that links posts to products, social login, PWA push notifications and a custom admin panel for products, inventory, orders and customers.

Built with SvelteKit, Hono.js, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL, Redis and Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: ShopEase
projects.description:
ShopEase is a full-featured e-commerce app built with Next.js, Node.js, and Stripe, featuring JWT auth, an admin panel, and a responsive design for a secure, seamless shopping experience.

The ShopEase backend uses Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and JWT to handle secure auth, product & order management, and Stripe payments with reliable, real-time performance.

projects.title: Blood Bridge Foundation
projects.description: Built a secure and user-centric full-stack blood donation platform using the MERN stack. Features include hospital and organization directories, donor registration, blood request system with validation, and a public request dashboard. Implemented secure access to donor info via modal authentication and used Firebase for auth and database management.

projects.title: Smart-Star School
projects.tagline: Real Life Preliminary School Web Project
projects.description:
Solo project built with React, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, Web3Form and Framer Motion.

SmartStar School is a colorful, kid-friendly educational website built to make early learning fun and engaging. I developed it using React for interactivity, Tailwind CSS for clean design, and Framer Motion for smooth animations. It's fully responsive, playful, and built with young users in mind.

projects.title: HexTech
projects.description: Developed a MERN stack portfolio app using Next.js for SEO and performance. Collaborated in a team to integrate AOS, GSAP, and Framer Motion for smooth animations. Added dynamic email with Nodemailer, interactive maps, sliders, and responsive UI with TailwindCSS.

projects.title: LoneOrbit
projects.description: A marketplace built with React and Tailwind, allowing employers to manage jobs and bids, while bidders can place and track bids. Features include secure login, private routes, real-time updates, and optional bid deadlines.

projects.title: Dev-Challenges
projects.description: A dynamic web project that fetches real-time data from an external API. Users can browse, read, and bookmark content, with the ability to manage and delete bookmarks. The site is interactive, responsive, and built with modern web development practices for a smooth experience.

projects.title: Quick Quiz
projects.description: An interactive quiz platform with real-time answers, a countdown timer, answer preview, and a result summary showing scores and comparisons. It features a user-friendly, responsive interface.

projects.title: Portfolio Website

faqs.question: What do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: Software quality assurance: manual and functional testing, test automation with Cypress, regression, API and end-to-end testing. Before QA, I worked as a front-end and full-stack developer with React.js, Next.js, Svelte and TypeScript.

faqs.question: Where do you work now?
faqs.answer: I'm an SQA Engineer Trainee / Junior SQA Engineer at Spectrum Software & Consulting (SSCL) in Dhaka, testing OptiFin, a Supply Chain Finance solution used by leading banks in Bangladesh.

faqs.question: Which testing tools do you use?
faqs.answer: Cypress, Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, TestNG, JMeter and Postman for testing and automation, with TestRail and Jira for test management and bug tracking.

faqs.question: What kind of testing have you done on real projects?
faqs.answer: Functional, regression and on-site User Acceptance Testing at client bank headquarters for OptiFin, plus manual QA for the Artcon and Ryoko Travel Agency websites at Edistys — designing and executing 120+ test cases.
